test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 15 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which company announced plans to launch a quantum computing centre in Amaravati, Andhra Pradesh, by March 2026?
solution:
The correct answer is __**IBM**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **IBM** announced its plans to establish a **quantum computing centre** in **Amaravati, Andhra Pradesh**, by **March 2026**.
 
• This centre is expected to serve as a hub for **quantum research and innovation**, fostering advancements in fields such as **artificial intelligence (AI), data science, cryptography**, and material science.
 
• **Quantum computing** leverages principles of quantum mechanics, offering computational capabilities far beyond traditional computers, addressing complex problems in industries like healthcare, finance, and logistics.
 
• IBM has been a global leader in quantum computing, having developed the **IBM Q System One**, the world's first integrated quantum computing system for commercial use.
 
• The quantum computing centre in Amaravati aligns with the **Government of India's vision** to promote cutting-edge technologies and attract investments in the tech sector.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **IBM:**

 
 
• **Founded:** 1911 as the Computing-Tabulating-Recording Company (CTR); renamed IBM in 1924.
 
• **Headquarters:** Armonk, New York, USA.
 
• **Specializations:** Cloud computing, AI, blockchain, and quantum computing technologies.
 
• IBM has invested heavily in **quantum computing research**, offering cloud-based quantum computing services through the **IBM Quantum Experience** platform.
 
 
 
• **Quantum Computing:**
 
 
• Quantum computers use **qubits** instead of traditional bits, enabling them to perform multiple calculations simultaneously.
 
• Applications include **drug discovery, optimization problems, cryptographic systems, and simulations**.
 
• Quantum computing is expected to revolutionize industries by solving problems beyond the capabilities of classical computers.
 
 
 
• **Amaravati, Andhra Pradesh:**
 
 
• Planned as a **modern capital city** for Andhra Pradesh, Amaravati is envisioned to be a hub for innovation and technology.
 
• The establishment of the quantum computing centre in Amaravati will enhance its global reputation as a **technology-driven city**.
 
 
 
• **Government Initiatives:**
 
 
• The **National Quantum Mission** launched by the Government of India aims to promote research and development in quantum technologies.
 
• Such initiatives are designed to position India as a global leader in advanced technologies like **quantum computing**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **IBM Q System One:** The world's first integrated quantum computing system designed for commercial use, enabling businesses to access advanced quantum computing capabilities.
 
• **Quantum Mechanics:** The foundational principle behind quantum computing, focusing on phenomena like **superposition** and **entanglement**.
 
• **Global Quantum Initiatives:** Countries like the USA, China, and India are investing heavily in quantum computing research to gain strategic advantages in technology.
 
• **Andhra Pradesh's Tech Vision:** The state aims to attract investments in emerging technologies and establish itself as a tech-driven region through projects like the IBM quantum computing centre.
